description: Inspect the authenticated workspace's subscription tier (`free`, `starter`, `builder`, `scale`), active social account connections versus plan quota limits (3, 12, 35, or 100), monthly posts published, API key prefix, Stripe billing status, and connected brand profiles. Use this read-only diagnostic tool before connecting new social accounts or publishing high-volume campaigns to verify quota availability and account readiness. Returns a structured summary object containing `workspace`, `planLimits`, `usage`, `billing`, `profiles`, and `connectedAccounts`.

apiKey.description: Optional Nuntior Bearer API key (`ntr_live_...`) override when not supplied via the HTTP `Authorization` header.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace identifier (`ws_...`) to inspect a specific tenant workspace when managing multiple workspaces.

name: account_status
title: Inspect Account Status & Plan Quotas
